title: Meskine planned welcome/fantasia for Finance Minister Louis Paul Motaze
reason: Pro-government welcome/support gathering, with no established demand against the state; separate alleged protest is retained as pending evidence.
notes: Gazelle says about 15,000 were mobilized for a welcome at the Lamido’s court, while Africa-Press says the market was closed to mobilize people for ministerial reception. The number is not protest attendance.
